description: This file defines the AgeGroup class, which is a filter field used within the reporting module of the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionality to filter employees based on their age groups using SQL query modifications.

classes.name: AgeGroup
classes.description: A filter field class used to apply age-based filters on employee data in reports.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the provided query builder to include conditions based on the age filter operator and values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used within this filter, mainly 'employee'.
